iboxs31_sdcard_init.tooltip: Powers the card (IO39 low) and mounts it over 1-bit SDMMC at /sdcard; FAT/FAT32 only, never formatted. The self-test writes, reads back and deletes a temporary file

iboxs31_sdcard_state.tooltip: Mounted: a FAT card is inserted; read/write OK: the self-test write and read-back matched (false without a self-test)

iboxs31_sdcard_size.tooltip: Total card capacity in GB; 0 when not mounted

iboxs31_sdcard_status.tooltip: Self-test result: OK (mounted and read/write fine), R/W? (mounted but read/write failed), FAIL (not mounted), -- (not checked yet)

iboxs31_sdcard_write.tooltip: Write replaces the file; append adds to its end. Paths start with /, such as /log.txt; add a newline to the text yourself

iboxs31_sdcard_read.tooltip: Reads the whole file as text; empty if it is missing or the card is not mounted. Large files use a lot of memory

iboxs31_sdcard_exists.tooltip: Whether the file or folder exists

iboxs31_sdcard_remove.tooltip: Deletes the file; this cannot be undone
